entities.summary: The Fiorello H. LaGuardia High School of Music and Art and Performing Arts is a public high school in the Lincoln Square neighborhood of the Upper West Side in Manhattan, New York City. It specializes in teaching visual arts and performing arts. It is operated by the New York City Department of Education.
